skill.name: image-enhancer
skill.description: Improves the quality of images, especially screenshots, by enhancing resolution, sharpness, and clarity. Perfect for preparing images for presentations, documentation, or social media posts.
skill.summary: Guides image and screenshot enhancement for clearer documentation, presentations, and social media assets.
skill.author: DYAI2025

content.value_statement: Low-quality screenshots can make documentation, presentations, and social posts hard to read. This skill guides enhancement, upscaling, sharpening, artifact reduction, and output choices.
actual_capabilities: Guides quality analysis for resolution, sharpness, and compression artifacts.
Provides prompt patterns for screenshot, photo, and folder enhancement requests.
Supports enhancement targets for web, print, social media, and presentations.
Recommends preserving original files before creating enhanced versions.
Describes enhancement reports with current specs, applied changes, and saved filenames.
limitations: No bundled image processing script or model is included.
Batch edits depend on the host assistant's filesystem and image tool access.
Results cannot restore details that are absent from the original image.
The skill does not define exact quality metrics or reproducible processing parameters.

use_cases.title: Clean Documentation Screenshots
use_cases.description: Improve screenshots so interface text, icons, and layout details remain readable in product documentation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Presentation Assets
use_cases.description: Upscale and sharpen images before placing them on large slides or executive reports.

use_cases.title: Optimize Social Media Images
use_cases.description: Adjust image clarity and format choices for posts on social platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Enhance One Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve the clarity of this screenshot and save an enhanced copy. Keep the original file unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Sharpen Blurry Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Sharpen this screenshot for documentation. Prioritize readable interface text and avoid over-processing.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for Presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Upscale this image for a widescreen presentation. Reduce artifacts and report the final resolution and file size.

prompt_templates.title: Batch Enhance Folder
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance all PNG screenshots in this folder for web documentation. Preserve originals and add a clear suffix to each output file.

output_examples.input: Improve the image quality of screenshot-2024.png.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports the current resolution, notes slight blur, sharpens edges, improves text clarity, and saves an enhanced copy.

output_examples.input: Enhance all PNG files in this directory for documentation.
output_examples.output: The assistant processes each image, preserves originals, applies consistent sharpening, and summarizes each output filename.

output_examples.input: Prepare this compressed product image for a LinkedIn post.
output_examples.output: The assistant reduces visible compression artifacts, checks social media sizing needs, and recommends an output format.

best_practices: Start with the highest quality source image available.
State the target use case, such as web, print, presentation, or social media.
Keep original files unchanged so results can be compared or reverted.
anti_patterns: Do not expect the skill to recreate information missing from the source image.
Do not batch process important folders without confirming output naming.
Do not apply heavy sharpening when natural photos should remain realistic.

faq.question: Does this skill include an image processing program?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and prompts for image enhancement workflows in supported assistants.

faq.question: Can it improve screenshots for documentation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is designed for clearer screenshots, sharper text, and cleaner documentation images.

faq.question: Can it process multiple images?
faq.answer: Yes, when the host assistant can access the folder and image tools needed for batch processing.

faq.question: Will it overwrite my original files?
faq.answer: The instructions recommend preserving originals and saving enhanced copies with clear filenames.

faq.question: Which formats does it mention?
faq.answer: The skill mentions PNG for quality and JPG for smaller file sizes.

faq.question: Is it useful for social media images?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests naming the target platform so sizing and format choices can match the use case.
